message: ライカ
Between training and Student Council duties today, too.
Time flew by in the blink of an eye.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Feels like we really put in the work today, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up, Synn? You don't have patrol today, do you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just remembered an errand I have to run」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oops, I just remembered something too!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know. You've got grocery shopping for dinner today, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ngh~~」
Azel was in the photobook section.
She was sitting on a stepladder leaned against the bookshelf, reading a photobook.
She was reading so intently that I hesitated to call out to her.
In the deserted library, I listened to the sound of Azel turning the pages.
As if reluctant to part with them, she kept flipping back to earlier pages, making her progress slow.
The fluorescent light formed a halo on her glossy hair.
I felt like I was seeing a girl this pretty for the very first time.
I was pulled back to reality from that strange moment--one that stirred something deep inside my chest, yet wasn't unpleasant--when Azel closed the photobook and let out a sigh.

name: Azel
message: 「Hm?」
Our eyes suddenly met.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um, I didn't mean to interrupt」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like--」
Azel started to say, then faltered and turned her face away.

name: Synn
message: 「'It's not like I'm moved or anything,' right」

name: Azel
message: 「......Even if I said that now, you wouldn't believe me anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't mind believing you, though」

name: Azel
message: 「You don't have to believe it」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Isn't it pointless, though?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Ahem」
Azel cleared her throat, stepped down from the stepladder, and,

name: Azel
message: 「What do you think?」
She opened the photo book she had been looking at until just now and thrust it toward me.

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you ask me out of nowhere」
Rather than a foreign town straight off a postcard, it was a photo book capturing ordinary street corners of this country--places much like Ryuusei Town, so to speak.

name: Azel
message: 「It's different」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... from what?」

name: Azel
message: 「From mine」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, from the ones you took, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed」

name: Azel
message: 「Why does an utterly ordinary scene appear as something special, unlike what we see every day?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... because they're pros」

name: Azel
message: 「This was taken by a photographer whose main profession is teaching」

name: Synn
message: 「Then they're just skilled. Or maybe it's their eye for it? Both, I guess」

name: Azel
message: 「There is this as well」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「Under equipment used, it says Leica R6」
If I remember right, Leica is a famous camera brand.

name: Synn
message: 「...Are you saying it's because they didn't use a digital camera?」

name: Azel
message: 「There were several books that stated the same equipment was used」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think that's the only reason, though」

name: Azel
message: 「However, using the same tool might allow me to see something new. It is a rational line of thought」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm」

name: Azel
message: 「Have you ever used one?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope. Never」

name: Melilot
message: 「Here you go」
In front of each of us sat a teacup filled with amber-colored black tea.

name: Azel
message: 「...Th-thank you」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well done」
She must have been taught to say thank you.

name: Synn
message: 「May I have some too?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, you'll be the only one with nothing, is that alright?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for the tea」
An empty library.
Melilot-san, Azel, and I sit around a single table.

name: Synn
message: 「Since when?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ever since I found her hiding in the shadow of a bookshelf after curfew, looking at photo books.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I wasn't hiding. I just lost track of time before I knew it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though she only started eating the biscuits the day after you treated her to ramen.」

name: Azel
message: 「R-ramen has nothing to do with it」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's leave it at that.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's nothing」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. Melilot-san, do you know about a camera called Leica?」

name: Azel
message: 「W-why are you asking that?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I used to use one in the past.」

name: Synn
message: 「There you go, Azel. If you have something you want to ask, go ahead and ask」

name: Azel
message: 「I-it's not like I have anything I want to ask」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of camera is it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unlike a digital camera, it takes quite a bit of work」
Azel leaned forward just a little.

name: Azel
message: 「You don't just press the button?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You have to check the lighting and the distance to the subject, and adjust it yourself」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. It requires such delicate adjustments」

name: Melilot
message: 「I should have it put away somewhere, so I'll look for it」

name: Azel
message: 「N-no, there's no need for that. It's an old-fashioned thing, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd love to see it」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you want to see it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's have her show us together」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah... like I said」

name: Synn
message: 「Right?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Sigh」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-why are you looking at my face!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You've become quite expressive, haven't you」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-you're imagining things!」
Azel suddenly downed the rest of his black tea. He stood up.

name: Azel
message: 「I-I'm leaving」

name: Melilot
message: 「Where's my 'thank you for the tea'?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Thank you for the tea」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well done」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yes」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please see him out」
Azel didn't try to drive me away, though he didn't open his mouth for a while.

name: Azel
message: 「...It's your fault」
As usual, it came out of nowhere, and on top of that, it was hard to understand.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Because you treated me to ramen. I found out」
His usual pose, talking without looking my way.
Somehow, I feel like I'm always looking at Azel's profile.

name: Synn
message: 「Found out what?」

name: Azel
message: 「Vandine Jelly tastes awful」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. It sure does」

name: Azel
message: 「My food expenses have gone up」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I see. So you've started eating other things too」
So that's why he has biscuits.

name: Azel
message: 「It's wasteful, completely wasteful. Illogical. Mere nutritional supp--」

name: Azel
message: 「Why am I even telling you this in the first place?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm enjoying it, though」

name: Azel
message: 「...You are always illogical. I don't understand you」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. I think I'm a pretty simple guy, though」
Azel fell silent again.
Every time a shooting star streaked across the sky, twinkling softly, his profile was faintly illuminated.

name: Azel
message: 「...Why did you come」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「To the library?」

name: Azel
message: 「At such a late hour」

name: Synn
message: 「You're really into photography, Azel, and it seems like you're at the academy past dismissal time a lot, so I wondered if you were staying late again」

name: Azel
message: 「It shouldn't be a patrol day」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why, well, I was worried about you, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「You worry about anyone」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you're especially reckless, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「...Reckless, you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That's why I feel like I can't take my eyes off you」

name: Azel
message: 「You are far more perilous」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Azel
message: 「You converse calmly with hideous creatures, and even go so far as to find them employment」

name: Synn
message: 「They aren't hideous. Not really」

name: Synn
message: 「Even you want to eat delicious food, don't you, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless. As long as nutrients are replenished, that is enough」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, good-tasting food is better than bad-tasting food, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Appearances aren't really a big deal」

name: Synn
message: 「Even problems caused by all sorts of differences can be solved if everyone puts their heads and strength together. Even if you can't do it alone, you'll be fine with everyone else」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that why」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it because you are not alone that you can fight strong opponents, despite not being strong yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I'm sure that's it」
Azel fell silent.
That silence somehow seemed lonely.
